description: This file defines an ASP.NET Web Forms page code-behind for the AdminLeaderboard page in an online examination system. It handles page load events and button click events, with some database-related code commented out. It also manages navigation between pages.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: A partial class for the AdminLeaderboard ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling user interactions and page logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently, any database interaction code is commented out.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button, currently empty.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected semester text into session; contains commented code for database search functionality.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the LoginPage.
